# Wisconsin Board Sizes

> Every video board, ribbon, table and IPTV canvas at Camp Randall, the Kohl Center, the Field House, LaBahn Arena and Goodman Diamond (Wisconsin Athletics). Manifest 2026-10-08.2, updated 2026-10-08.

Use this whenever you create or check anything that will play on a Wisconsin venue board: After Effects comps, Photoshop/Illustrator artboards, templates, render presets, code that lays out or validates board content, and sponsor or Colosseum deliverables.

## Rules for agents

1. Never hardcode or guess a board size. Look it up here every time; read `version` and say which one you used.
2. Refer to boards by `id` (e.g. `camp-randall/north-board/main-video-fg`), or by canvas `key` (e.g. `MAIN_VIDEO`) in production tools. Names can carry typos from the processor; ids and keys never change.
3. Positions are `{x, y}` from the display's top-left. Sizes are width × height in pixels.
4. Check `issues` before final delivery. `conflict` = sources disagree, `tbd` = value not final, `unconfirmed` = only one source, `naming` = zone names may change. Surface them to the user; never resolve one silently.
5. Respect delivery specs: `fps`, `stillOnly`, `duration`, `pad` (keep content that many px inside every edge), `audio`. When `fps` is null, ask or use 59.94.
6. FG/BG zones are two processor layers of one window. Build one asset unless the content needs both.
7. To change a size, edit `public/board-sizes/boards.json` in the Wisconsin Creative repo and run `node scripts/build-board-sizes.mjs`. Never edit the generated files.

## Files

- [index.json](https://wisconsincreative.com/board-sizes/index.json): start here. One flat record per display and zone (223), with id, size, aspect, positions, fps, delivery, canvas keys, issues and a deep link. Also canvases and content types resolved to ids.
- [boards.json](https://wisconsincreative.com/board-sizes/boards.json): the hand-edited source (schema `wisconsin-board-sizes/1`). Pin this exact file for production tools; the After Effects Board Builder does.
- [boards.schema.json](https://wisconsincreative.com/board-sizes/boards.schema.json): JSON Schema for boards.json.
- [boards.csv](https://wisconsincreative.com/board-sizes/boards.csv): index.json as a spreadsheet.
- [Board Sizes](https://wisconsincreative.com/board-sizes): the human page. `?v=<venue>#<id>` opens one board; `?c=<content id>` lists every canvas a piece of content needs.

## Lookup recipes

```js
const idx = await (await fetch("https://wisconsincreative.com/board-sizes/index.json")).json();
const board = idx.boards.find((b) => b.id === "camp-randall/north-board/main-video-fg"); // { w: 3096, h: 1440, fps: 60, ... }
const byKey = idx.canvases.find((c) => c.key === "KC_MAIN");
const touchdown = idx.content.find((c) => c.id === "score-touchdown").boards.map((id) => idx.boards.find((b) => b.id === id));
```

```python
import json, urllib.request
idx = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://wisconsincreative.com/board-sizes/index.json"))
sizes = {b["id"]: (b["w"], b["h"]) for b in idx["boards"]}
```

After Effects: use the Board Builder (pins boards.json with the `boards` CLI), or the site's "AE comps" button on any content type.

## Open issues

Zones inherit their display's issues in index.json.

- `camp-randall/north-board/gip` (tbd, h): GIP 3096 × 155 is marked “TBD size” in the Board Info sheet and doesn’t appear in the 2024 guide or Colosseum’s list.
- `kohl-center/centerhung-main`, `kohl-center/main-16-9-feed`, `kohl-center/centerhung-top-ring`, `kohl-center/360-fascia`, `kohl-center/300-level-tunnels`, `kohl-center/scorers-table`, `kohl-center/stanchion`, `kohl-center/baseline-table` (conflict, fps): Frame rate differs by source: Colosseum builds at 60 fps; the production After Effects project renders at 59.94. Confirm before final delivery.
- `kohl-center/main-16-9-feed` (unconfirmed): Only in Colosseum’s list; not in the Board Info sheet. Confirm with the Kohl Center video board team before building for it.
- `field-house/table` (naming): Zone names and folder structure will change when the table is plugged in.
- `field-house/table` (naming): The sheet lists “Left GIP-BG” twice (zones 6 and 8); zone 8 is probably Right GIP-BG.
- `goodman/main` (unconfirmed): Only in Colosseum’s list; the Board Info sheet’s Goodman tab is empty. Confirm before final delivery.

## Camp Randall (`camp-randall`)

- Deliver final files 2 weeks before the season opener, or 1 week before an event once the season is underway (2024 guide).
- Full-system features and replay wipes are designed by UW Video Services: send RGB vector logos (.ai or .eps) for black, white and colored backgrounds, labeled.
- Badger Sports Properties partners deliver through their representative; others deliver digitally (Box, Dropbox, FTP).

- 2026-10-08.1: Agent-ready: stable ids on every display and zone, positions as {x, y}, open questions as typed `issues`, `notes` everywhere for plain information, `stillOnly` on zones to match canvases. Generated index.json, boards.csv and llms.txt. Canvas keys and every size are unchanged.
- 2026-09-24.1: First published manifest: five venues cross-referenced from the Board Info sheet, the 2024 Camp Randall guide, Colosseum’s deliverables sheet and the Board Builder; 58 canvas keys.
